title: Use "echo 'search.file /.disk/info root' > tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg"
commit_message:
Use "echo 'search.file /.disk/info root' > tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg"
to find the correct rootfs. Needed because now debian-cd builds risc-v
ISOs and does not set disk label to 'live-media' as it used to. The
disk label of an ISO filesystem is the so-called volume-id, which is
usually set to a build-dependent string, usually something like
'Ubuntu-Server 25.04 riscv'. (LP: #2104572)
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 919efd5..0143226 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+cd-boot-images-riscv64 (12.2) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Use "echo 'search.file /.disk/info root' > tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg"
+             to find correct rootfs, as now debian-cd builds risc-v ISOs and does
+             not set disk label to 'live-media' as it used to. (LP: #2104572)
+
+ -- Adriano Cordova <adriano.cordova@canonical.com>  Thu, 27 Mar 2025 16:02:55 -0300
+
 cd-boot-images-riscv64 (12.1) noble; urgency=medium
 
   * Rebuild against grub2 2.12-1ubuntu7.1 and u-boot 2024.01+dfsg-1ubuntu5.1
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 3779339..357a64e 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -98,7 +98,7 @@ override_dh_auto_build:
 	  --format 'riscv64-efi' \
 	  $(CD_MODULES)
 	
-	echo 'search.fs_label live-media root' > tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg
+	echo 'search.file /.disk/info root' > tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg
 	echo 'set prefix=($$root)'\''/boot/grub'\''' >> tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg
 	echo 'configfile $$prefix/grub.cfg' >> tree/EFI/boot/grub.cfg
